# ghost_organization_public_membership (Resource)

Makes the membership of an organization public or private for the user the provider's token belongs to. A public membership shows that user on the organization's People tab to everyone, and the organization on their profile; a private one is seen only by the organization's other members.

Ghost only lets a user change their own membership, so this resource has no username argument and can't publicize anyone else; the user must already be a member of the organization. `public` defaults to `true`, so the resource's presence makes the membership public; set it to `false` to keep it private and have Terraform put it back if someone makes it public. **Destroying the resource always makes the membership private**, whatever it was before Terraform. A membership flipped outside Terraform shows up as drift, and the resource drops out of state if the user leaves the organization.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Make the token user's membership of my-org public. Ghost only lets a user
# change their own membership, so there's no username. Destroy makes it
# private again.
resource "ghost_organization_public_membership" "example" {
  organization = "my-org"
}

# Or keep it private, reverting it if someone makes it public:
#
#   public = false
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `organization` (String) The organization's slug, matched case-insensitively and kept as configured. Changing it to another organization forces a new resource (making the old membership private); changing only its case doesn't.

### Optional

- `public` (Boolean) Whether the membership is public. Defaults to `true`. Changing it updates the resource in place.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The organization's slug, in lower case.
- `username` (String) The login of the token's user, whose membership this is.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The token user's membership is imported by the organization's slug.
terraform import ghost_organization_public_membership.example my-org
```
